name: Attack Shark X3
author: Aeon Arc
description: Battery, DPI, polling rate, sensor and button settings of the ATTACK SHARK X3 wireless mouse in the Omarchy bar, over its 2.4G receiver or USB cable and without the Windows driver.

barWidget.description: Battery level of the ATTACK SHARK X3 mouse; click for DPI, polling, sensor, timing and button settings. Needs the udev rule from the plugin's README.

schema.label: Show percentage
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the mouse glyph. Off leaves only the glyph; the tooltip still has the level.
